blocks.heading: Choose your next version
blocks.body: Choose a specific arrangement before starting. The cards below offer a reflective piece, a cheerful programme option, a familiar theme, an intermediate solo and an accompaniment resource.
blocks.evidence_status: [推断] editorial guidance using verified version metadata

blocks.heading: Sad or reflective
blocks.body: Gymnopédie No. 1 is our reflective selection because the publisher describes long phrases and wide bass-to-chord spacing. “Sad” is an editorial listening lens; it is not an objective property of every performance.
blocks.evidence_status: [推断] selection guidance; version facts verified in listed sources

blocks.heading: Happy, cool or fun
blocks.body: The Happy Farmer is a cheerful-title selection. Addams Family Theme is a theme-song choice for a playful programme. Their appeal depends on your audience and preferences.
blocks.evidence_status: [推断] selection guidance; version facts verified in listed sources

blocks.heading: Beautiful
blocks.body: For a spacious, reflective goal, audition the selected Gymnopédie. Choose the sound you want to work on; this is not a beauty ranking.
blocks.evidence_status: [推断] selection guidance; version facts verified in listed sources

blocks.heading: Intermediate
blocks.body: The Gymnopédie edition is late intermediate and calls attention to long phrases and bass-to-chord spacing. Empire State of Mind is in an explicitly intermediate piano-solo collection; inspect its own sample before comparing the two.
blocks.evidence_status: [推断] selection guidance; version facts verified in listed sources

blocks.heading: Types of piece
blocks.body: The catalogue includes an étude route on the challenging page, a fantasy there, soundtrack tracks such as Sweden, simplified classical excerpts and songs arranged for singing. These labels help you choose a playing task.
blocks.evidence_status: [推断] selection guidance; version facts verified in listed sources

blocks.heading: Sing and play
blocks.body: All of Me has a vocal line and piano part with guitar chord frames. Start there when you need singing support; choose the Easy Songs page for a melody-first solo task.
blocks.evidence_status: [推断] selection guidance; version facts verified in listed sources

blocks.heading: Open the exact edition
blocks.body: Each resource names its edition and access route. Publisher difficulty labels describe that arrangement. Use the provider’s preview before purchasing; check the chosen digital format before expecting a printable PDF.
blocks.evidence_status: [推断] acquisition guidance

blocks.heading: Choose an easy version you can actually use
blocks.body: Start with the arrangement, not just the song title. The featured choices below identify a specific score or lesson and explain the next thing to check. Publisher labels such as Early Elementary and Easy Piano come from different series; treat them as starting points for comparing the actual music.
blocks.evidence_status: [推断] 编辑选择方法；依据所列出版方采用不同级别标签

blocks.heading: For a child’s first few pieces
blocks.body: Hot Cross Buns comes with first-lesson materials and a parent guide. The early-elementary Twinkle version adds a hand-position graphic and a matching tutorial. For a birthday goal, the early-elementary Happy Birthday divides the melody between the hands. Choose the version and lesson together.
blocks.evidence_status: [已核实] 版本功能；儿童起步选择为[推断]

blocks.heading: If you want a C-major version
blocks.body: The listed early-elementary Twinkle, Jingle Bells and Happy Birthday editions are in C major. The selected Ode to Joy arrangement is in D major, so it is outside this filter. A key name alone does not describe the rhythm, hand movement or reading work.
blocks.evidence_status: [已核实] 调性；难度比较建议为[推断]

blocks.heading: For adult beginners
blocks.body: If you follow Alfred’s adult course, compare The Rainbow Connection or Nadia’s Theme in its Greatest Hits Book 1 with your current lesson. If you want a broader menu, the edition-backed list offers fifty titles from one Easy Piano collection. Those are purchased arrangements, not fifty free downloads or fifty individually tested recommendations.
blocks.evidence_status: [已核实] 版本归属；选择为[推断]

blocks.heading: For a gentle piece or a small performance
blocks.body: For a gentle option, compare the two Twinkle arrangements and listen to their separate samples. For a small performance, choose a meaningful occasion: Happy Birthday gives you a clear audience and purpose. “Beautiful” and “impressive” describe your goal here; neither is a guaranteed listener response.
blocks.evidence_status: [推断] 主观编辑选择，依据标注Dreamily与生日场合；不承诺效果

blocks.heading: Before you commit
blocks.body: Open the exact resource, check how to obtain it, and try a short section at a comfortable pace. Prefer a version whose instructions you understand. Several free provider downloads request your name and email. For a printed copy, check the chosen format: an online digital book and a downloadable PDF are different products.
blocks.evidence_status: [推断] 编辑操作建议；获取方式已核实
